verdict.rationale: Fedora's own Workstation page directly claims the story: "Use the latest container tools from the Red Hat ecosystem. No setup required," with access to the Red Hat container registry and "tools for creating, running and managing containers." The releases data also lists a Container_Toolbox subvariant. The support is first-party marketing copy only: no specific tools are named and no hands-on account confirms they work out of the box. missing for 10: named container tooling and in-depth docs on what ships preinstalled, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-setup container experience
